title: Creamy Toor Dal Risotto
description: A rich and creamy risotto infused with the flavors of toor dal and a hint of Italian spices.
instructions: Heat the oozy in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the toor dal and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the risotto and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add 1 cup of water to the saucepan and stir until the water is absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding water and stirring until the risotto is cooked and creamy.
Stir in the italian and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with grated parmesan.
